## Problem

What user or engineering problem should this solve?

## Proposed acceptance criteria

What observable behavior would make this complete?

## Why HAL

Which existing HAL component, example, or documented invariant does this extend?

## Alternatives / interoperability

Can this be solved through an existing standard interface, MCP endpoint, provider adapter, or external project instead of adding a named special case?

## Safety / evidence considerations

Does this change authorization, privacy, provenance, provider cost, public claims, or human approval?
